name: Brisbane BNE3

address.note: Per datacentermap (search extract; page returned 429). Baxtel (read in full) gives '4 Cycas La'. DigiCo PDS says only '9,786 square metres of land adjacent to BNE2'. Street number unconfirmed.

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '6 Cycas Lane, Brisbane Airport QLD 4008' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (StreetAddressExt, score 98.9). Street-interpolated (StreetAddressExt), not an address point: approximate.

developer.note: HMC Capital-managed REIT. PDS: 'DigiCo REIT has an option to expand its current lease with Brisbane Airport Corporation to include this site.'

mw_it.note: PDS (Dec 2024), where the site was called BNE4: 'greenfield development estimated to deliver 19.6MW of IT Capacity and 2,496 approximately racks across on 9,786 square metres of land', tier 4. FY25 results (Aug 2025, source 5), after renaming to BNE3: '~10,000sqm ... expected to deliver 20MW of IT Capacity'.

authority.note: Brisbane Airport Corporation land: would need BAC consent + Airport Building Controller approval under the Airports (Building Control) Regulations 1996 (source 7). No approval found.

pathway.note: Airports Act 1996 building control; no application or approval found.

construction_end.note: Expected at PDS: 'Construction completion is estimated in calendar year 2027.' Superseded: by Aug 2025 DigiCo was still 'in discussions with Brisbane Airport Corporation' (source 5), and the FY26 results/Annual Report 2026 portfolio lists no BNE3 at all (source 6).
